item.title: v0.0.1
item.description:
First release of Simple Mac Fixes: one menu-bar app with a switch for each fix.
- Cut and paste files in Finder with ⌘X and ⌘V. - Traditional scrolling for wheel mice; trackpads and the Magic Mouse keep your System Settings direction. - Maximize windows with the green button or a title-bar double-click, drag the title bar to restore, and Option-click the green button for full screen. - Click a Dock app with more than one window to see them in App Exposé; Option-click a Dock folder to open it in Finder. - Volume and brightness keys for audio interfaces, USB DACs and external monitors.
Replaces Macsimize, Dockmint and Simple Mac Keyboard Control, which quit automatically while Simple Mac Fixes runs. Overlapping utilities such as LinearMouse, Mos and DockDoor quit too while the matching fix is on.
